$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.common.nullsafety. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-NULLABLE-FLOW-REPORT-INDEX
arms.note: the flow seed asks the REPORT index again, so a nullable-returning member declared outside the reported files stops seeding anything

arms.name: M-NULLABLE-INDEX-EXCLUSION
arms.note: the exclusion key can never match, so `Array.pop` comes back through the index lookup the build-time filter never sees and the length-guarded accessors seed the flow again

arms.name: M-NULLABLE-REPORT-INDEX
arms.note: the cross-file return arc asks the REPORT index again, so every member declared outside the reported files is unknown and the arc is dead where it matters

arms.name: M-DECL-NULLABLE-BLIND
arms.note: the written `Null<T>` on a local declaration stops being evidence, so a receiver no nullable EXPRESSION feeds goes back to Unknown and the declaration-side half of the flow seed is dead

arms.name: M-NULLABLE-NO-CHAIN
arms.note: the receiver type is the written annotation or nothing, so every field-path / call receiver falls back to unknown and the null family stops seeing the sources only the chain resolver names

arms.name: M-NULLABLE-FLOW-EXCLUDE-NONE
arms.note: nothing is excluded from the flow seed, so Reflect.copy and the length-guarded collection accessors seed MaybeNull again and every write through the result is a Warning

arms.name: M-DECL-INIT-NONNULL-BLIND
arms.note: no initializer is ever proved non-null, so the declaration seed fires again over a redundant `Null<T>` whose value cannot be null

arms.name: M-DECL-INIT-TERNARY-ANY-ARM
arms.note: one proven arm carries the whole ternary, so `flag ? a : null` reads as non-null and a real NPE goes silent

arms.name: M-DECL-INIT-LITERAL-BLIND
arms.note: a bare literal arm is judged by the chain resolver alone, which types an Int literal and an array or object literal by its slot type but not against a typedef it cannot see, so a ternary with such a [] or {} branch stays seeded

arms.name: M-DECL-INIT-RECEIVER-MODE-NOMINAL
arms.note: the initializer is typed through the RECEIVER arc, which peels `Null<>`, so a field declared `Null<T>` reads as non-null and its seed is dropped

arms.name: M-DSN-NULLSAFE-ALWAYS
arms.note: plain code is treated as null-checked, so a runtime-sound Bool-local proof loses its fix (dead-safe-nav, dead-null-guard, dead-null-coalescing) where nothing typechecks it

arms.name: M-DSN-MACRO-BLIND
arms.note: a project-wide `--macro nullSafety` in the oracle hxml is ignored, so a meta-free module gets the `.` rewrite its build rejects

arms.name: M-DSN-HXML-ALWAYS-ON
arms.note: every oracle build reads as enabling null-safety, so a plain project loses the runtime-sound fix

arms.name: M-DSN-HXML-COMMENT-READ
arms.note: a commented-out `#--macro nullSafety` is read as live, so the fix is declined in a plain build

arms.name: M-DSN-HXML-LIB-PLAIN
arms.note: a `-lib` is taken as plain although its extraParams may add `@:nullSafety`, so the build-breaking fix lands

arms.name: M-DSN-HXML-INCLUDE-SKIPPED
arms.note: an included hxml is never read, so a `nullSafety` macro in it goes unseen and the build-breaking fix lands

arms.name: M-DSN-HXML-UNREADABLE-PLAIN
arms.note: an oracle hxml not generated yet reads as plain, so the fix lands before the build that may reject it exists

arms.name: M-NULLPASS-MUTATES
arms.find: if (guarded == null || subtreeMutates(guarded, seams.unsafeKinds)) return null;
arms.note: a guarded value that calls is collapsed from two evaluations to one

arms.name: M-NULLCOAL-NULL-FALLBACK
arms.note: a null fallback is rewritten to the no-op `x ?? null` instead of the guarded value

arms.name: M-REDUNDANT-COAL-NULL-RIGHT
arms.note: `x ?? null` is no longer reported, so the no-op coalescing a rule cascade or a hand writes survives

arms.name: M-DNG-UNSEEN-DROPPED
arms.find: declineReason: gate.unseenProofReason(entry.file, root, compared.span, shape, facts, compared.name, UNSEEN_CONSEQUENCE)
arms.note: a guard proven only through a Bool local / alias / lone if-arm / try is offered for removal under null-safety, so `return reads ? node : other` fails `Cannot return nullable value` (the N25 FactsView revert)

arms.name: M-DNG-DECLINED-FIXED
arms.note: a declined dead guard is removed anyway, so the build-breaking edit reaches the oracle net again

arms.name: M-DNC-UNSEEN-DROPPED
arms.find: declineReason: gate.unseenProofReason(entry.file, root, left.span, shape, facts, left.name, UNSEEN_CONSEQUENCE)
arms.note: a `??` proven only through a Bool local is unwrapped under null-safety by a SAFE fix, and `return node` breaks the build with no net

arms.name: M-DNC-DECLINED-FIXED
arms.note: a declined dead fallback is unwrapped anyway, so the build-breaking safe fix lands

arms.name: M-NSG-GATE-NEVER
arms.note: null-safety is never on, so every unseen proof keeps its rewrite and the three checks break a @:nullSafety build

arms.name: M-NSG-VISIBLE-IGNORED
arms.note: a proof the compiler follows counts as unseen too, so a nested-guard / early-exit removal the compiler accepts is declined

arms.name: M-GSN-VALUE-TAIL
arms.note: a run that is a used block's value is wrapped in a Void guard, which no longer compiles

arms.name: M-RNC-CALL-WINDOW
arms.note: a call between the copy and its last use no longer keeps the copy, so the field is read again after a call that may have rewritten it

arms.name: M-RNC-WRITE-WINDOW
arms.note: a write taking effect before the last use no longer keeps the copy, so the field is read again after it changed

arms.name: M-RNC-WRAPPED-USE
arms.note: a use inside a loop or a function literal opened after the copy no longer keeps it, so the field is read again per iteration or at a later call

arms.name: M-RNC-NULL-COMPARED
arms.note: a copy no null check reads is flagged too, which is the join-single-use-local rule's case and not a narrowing copy

arms.name: M-RNC-READ-ONLY
arms.note: a write of the copy is no longer a refusal, so a copy that is reassigned is rewritten into a write of the field

arms.name: M-RNC-INTERPOLATED
arms.note: a braceless $copy inside a string is rewritten to the field text, which reads only the first name of a chain

arms.name: M-RNC-LOCAL-COPY
arms.note: a copy of a local or a parameter is taken for a copy of a field, though there is nothing to read directly

arms.name: M-RNC-REDECLARED
arms.note: a name the field path reads declared again in the window no longer refuses, so the text the copy becomes binds to the new declaration

arms.name: M-RNC-CHAIN-GUARDED
arms.note: a field chain first read under a branch or after a short-circuit is rewritten, so a null link that threw at the copy is never read

arms.name: M-RNC-COMMENT
arms.note: a comment on the copy's line is deleted with it

arms.name: M-RNC-FACTS-ALWAYS
arms.note: the thread facts are never asked, so a project that declares nothing about its writers gets the rewrite

arms.name: M-RNC-FIX-TEXT
arms.note: a use of the copy is left as it was, so the dropped declaration leaves an unbound name

arms.name: M-RNC-FIX-DROP
arms.note: the copy's declaration stays, so the rewrite leaves a dead local

arms.name: M-RNC-COPY-TYPE
arms.find: return declared != null && bare(written, scan) == bare(declared, scan);
arms.note: a copy written as an abstract the field converts into is read as the field, so its uses pick the abstract's members no longer

arms.name: M-RNC-REFLECTIVE-CLASSES
arms.note: the classes the config declares reflective are not read, so a reflective write of a type parameter is taken to reach any field

arms.name: M-NULLSAFETY-GATE-NOTES-DROPPED
arms.note: the oracle read of a null-safety gate bypasses the rule's run notes and says its config diagnostic on stderr, once per file instead of once per run

arms.name: M-RNC-FACTS-NOTES-DROPPED
arms.note: the thread facts of redundant-narrowing-copy walk the config chain without the rule's run notes: its diagnostics go to stderr
